title: Form definition
description: A multi-step form as a UCM-shaped schema: properties are UCM properties, steps are structure.layout entries of type step. Stored as UCF content of the form-definition model, or as the plain object in `fields`.

version.description: Raised on every publish; saved drafts record it and are checked against it on resume

resetDrafts.description: Raise to make saved drafts start over (when old answers no longer make sense)

present.description: How the form is shown. The rules and answers are the same in every mode

mode.description: steps: one step at a time with Back and Next; page: every step on the path at once, as sections; reveal: one page where the next section appears when the one before is complete

advance.description: auto: move on as soon as a step is complete and its last answer was a choice

submit.description: false: a calculator; no Send button, results update as the person answers

hidden.description: Left out unless a rule includes it

slots.description: Places where patch fields may land

condition.description: The name of a named condition in the rule set (a yes/no computed variable, read as vars.<name> === true), or JSON Logic. Write names in a form that is translated, so a translation carries no logic

panel.description: A result panel: text blocks and calculated values shown whichever step is current, never on the path

place.description: aside: beside the form when there is room, else after it; end: after the steps; start: before them

hidden.description: Left out unless a rule includes it

fields.description: Text blocks and calculated values only

type.description: content: a text block with no value (never submitted); file: uploads, whose value is [{ name, size, type }] and which are never saved in a draft; list: a repeating group, whose value is an array of rows (objects of items.properties)

kind.description: The field type from an installed type package (types/core.json, dk/cpr, …) the field was made from; tells an editor which settings to show. Optional: typeOf() infers it from type and ui.widget

content.description: Text block only: the text, plain; a blank line starts a new paragraph

from.description: Prefill from context.* or facts.* while the field has no answer (for example a hidden campaign value); vars.* makes a calculated field, whose value is always that rule-set variable

items.description: Repeating groups (type list) only: the fields of one row

consent.description: Consent fields (ui.widget consent) only: the wording and the notice it refers to, recorded with the answer

track.description: Choice fields with privacy none only: the chosen value may be sent to analytics

privacy.description: none: may be saved anywhere; personal: saved in drafts the person chose to keep; special (health, national id, …): never saved in a draft. Form fields default to none, patch fields to personal

accept.description: File fields: allowed types, as the accept attribute (.pdf,image/*)

maxSize.description: File fields: largest file in bytes

maxFiles.description: File fields: how many files (1 by default)

check.description: Names of host functions (evaluate input.functions) that check the value: null passes, { code, message, level? } fails

messages.description: Message per issue code (minimum, pattern, dk-cpr, …), replacing the default

source.description: A service in the rule set: on a choice field (select) it returns the list as [{ value, label }]; on a text field it suggests as the person types (q)

minLength.description: Text with a source: letters typed before suggestions are asked for (2)

note.description: Shown under the field while this choice is chosen; texts read it as {values.<field>.note}

widget.description: email, tel, url, date, time, textarea, radio, consent, hidden, range (slider), output (calculated), table (repeating group), suggest, or one from a widget package (rich-text, auto-suggest, data-grid, …)

format.description: How a number is shown as text (calculated values, placeholders): Intl.NumberFormat options, such as { "style": "currency", "currency": "DKK" }

step.description: Number and slider fields: the step between values

hidden.description: Hidden unless a rule shows it
